_doc: Overworld trainers. party = [[species, level], ...]; a species '@flag' is read from Game.flags at battle time (the Route 22 rival's starter). class = a GameState.TRAINER_PAYOUTS key; sight = metres (0 = never spots you, talk to fight); sprite is a sheet in assets/sprites/ in the 3x4 npc_*.png layout. Display name on banners = '<CLASS> <NAME>' (see Trainers.display_name). Real trainers: FRLG data from the Bulbapedia references only. Optional fields: reward (exact FRLG prize, overrides base x level), intro/defeat/after/lose lines, requires_flag / hidden_by_flag, scripted (loss does not white-out), arena [w, d] + center (a scene marker name) for gym battles, arena_color (the ground decal tint, stone grey in the gym), ai_think_scale, badge (awarded on win + '<badge>_badge' flag), done_flag / won_flag (set after any/winning battle), leave_after + leave_to [x, z] (the trainer walks off and is freed).

test_youngster.name: TEST
intro: (test) Let's battle!

bug_catcher_rick.name: Rick
intro:
Hey! You have POKéMON!
Come on!
Let's battle 'em!
after:
Ssh! You'll scare the bugs away.
Another time, okay?

bug_catcher_doug.name: Doug
intro:
Yo!
You can't jam out if you're a
POKéMON TRAINER!
defeat:
Huh?
I ran out of POKéMON!
after:
That totally stinks! I'm going to
catch some stronger ones!

bug_catcher_anthony.name: Anthony
intro:
I might be little, but I won't like
it if you go easy on me!
after: I lost some of my allowance…

bug_catcher_charlie.name: Charlie
intro: Did you know that POKéMON evolve?
after:
BUG POKéMON evolve quickly.
They're a lot of fun!

bug_catcher_sammy.name: Sammy
intro:
Hey, wait up!
What's the hurry? Why the rush?
defeat:
I give!
You're good at this!
after:
Sometimes, you can find stuff on
the ground.

I'm looking for the stuff I
dropped. Can you help me?

camper_liam.name: Liam
intro: Stop right there, kid!

You're ten thousand light-years 
from facing BROCK!
defeat:
Light-years isn't time…
It measures distance!
after:
You're pretty hot.
…But not as hot as BROCK!

brock.name: Brock
intro:
So, you're here. I'm BROCK.
I'm PEWTER's GYM LEADER.

My rock-hard willpower is evident
even in my POKéMON.

My POKéMON are all rock hard, and
have true-grit determination.

That's right - my POKéMON are all
the ROCK type!

Fuhaha! You're going to challenge
me knowing that you'll lose?

That's the TRAINER's honor that
compels you to challenge me.

Fine, then!
Show me your best!
defeat:
I took you for granted, and so
I lost.

As proof of your victory, I confer
on you this…the official POKéMON
LEAGUE BOULDERBADGE.
after:
There are all kinds of TRAINERS in
this huge world of ours.

You appear to be very gifted as a
POKéMON TRAINER.
So let me make a suggestion.

Go to the GYM in CERULEAN and test
your abilities.
badge_speech:
Just having the BOULDERBADGE makes
your POKéMON more powerful.

It also enables the use of the
move FLASH outside of battle.

Of course, a POKéMON must know the
move FLASH to use it.

rival_blue_route22.name: Blue
intro: {RIVAL}: Hey! {PLAYER}!

You're off to the POKéMON LEAGUE?
Forget about it!

You probably don't have any
BADGES, do you?

The guard won't let you through
without them.

By the way, did your POKéMON get
any stronger?
lose:
{RIVAL}: Yeah!
Am I great or what?
after:
I heard the POKéMON LEAGUE is
crawling with tough TRAINERS.

I have to figure out how to get
past them.

You should quit dawdling and get a
move on!
